title: Weak Hessian bounds along every RCD geodesic
exact_target: In a complete separable full-support RCD(K,N) metric measure space with finite $N>1$ and measure finite on bounded sets, let F be bounded and globally Lipschitz and G bounded and continuous. If Hess $F\leq G\cdot g$ weakly against compact test gradients and nonnegative compactly supported Lipschitz weights, does each constant-speed minimizing geodesic $\gamma :[0,1]\to X$ satisfy $(F\circ \gamma )\prime\prime \leq d(\gamma (0),\gamma (1))^{2}G\circ \gamma $ in distributions?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
